## Recovered observations

21 points (from FC-13) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appc-b9`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: inset angle 29.76, tan theta .5718, cohesion printed -1.87 or 11.87 (first character overstruck); seven markers, none at 734 psf; four stresses match FC-5B but avg density 95.20 against FC-5B mean 96.4; bound at PDF 147
- Codex: Computer fit; Avg. Density 95.20; phi 29.76; tan theta .5718; cohesion unreadable. Geometry and rate missing. Underlying test identities unresolved. Cohesion -1.87 or 11.87; overstruck character; density differs from C-5B. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. C-13, printed C-35, PDF 147
